title: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate one-shot UGC ads from a single product image
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to generate one-shot UGC ads from a single product image  
Expect ~30 seconds generation time for a one-shot UGC ad in Seedance 2.5  
Use up to 50 reference inputs in Seedance 2.5 to guide the output  
Leverage Seedance 2.5’s multimodal inputs (audio + image + video) to control the generated ad
